messages:
maya: Quick thread : proposing a different angle for BYOK+SOC2 evidence: tokenized audit artifacts + consent-minimized escrow. Goal: let auditors verify integrity without exposing plaintext unless customer authorizes.

sam: Love the integrity-first approach. Key questions: how do we prove non-repudiation without holding keys? Threshold signing or blind signatures? Auditors need reproducible chain-of-custody.

zhen: Eng constraints: we can emit compact token objects per session: {session_id, root_hash, signer_id}. Store payloads encrypted with customer KEK. For access we could use an escrow that stores only wrapped KEKs plus a quorum release mechanism.

rachel: Product note: auditors often want a portal where they can download evidence. Idea: auditor-portal that shows manifests + merkle proofs and allows time-limited download requests that route to customer for consent if payload decryption needed.

marco: Ops: retrieval SLA matrix needs to include consent latency. If a human must approve, SLA should reflect that. For emergency legal-hold, we should auto-bypass consent if contract includes explicit clause.

sam: Security: threshold release (2-of-3: customer operator + Redwood HSM + legal escrow) could work. Alternatively, use zero-knowledge proofs so auditors can verify outputs without plaintext. ZK is heavier.

zhen: Implementation sketch: runtime emits two artifacts daily: "manifest.ndjson" (metadata + hashes) and "token_table.csv" (session -> token). We create merkle roots and sign them with HSM. Example token semantics: ``token://tkn-abc123`` referencing a wrapped-KEK and blob pointer.

rachel: UX: product flags per-tenant: retention_policy, escrow_mode={none,customer-managed,threshold}, auditor_portal_enabled. Expose audit-scope report for SOC2/ISO mapping.

legal: Legal: escrow threshold models require explicit consent in contract. Also need to ensure we document what we will disclose to auditors and under what legal basis. We'll draft a clause; expect 10-14 days review.

marco: Ops runbook bullets: - If auditor requests bundle: produce manifest + merkle_proofs + token list. - If escrow-release required: kick off release workflow and log OIDC assertion + operator approval. - If legal-hold: freeze key-destruction and mark blobs as subject to hold.

sam: Cryptographic additions: - HSM-signed daily root with timestamped sig. - Per-token audit log with signer oidc and retrieval outcome. - Optional customer-HSM signing for customers that mandate it.

maya: Candidate launch checklist: product flags + API, HSM signing infra, tokenized manifest format, auditor portal proof-of-concept, legal escrow contract draft, pilot with one Fin customer.

rachel: Pilot plan: small FinPilot (EU) to test threshold escrow + auditor portal read-only. Gather auditor feedback on artifacts format (they prefer CSV + PDF manifest).

marco: Blockers: HSM capacity + infra changes, legal wording for threshold escrow, and auditor acceptance tests. I'll open infra ticket.

ops-bot: Created INF-6120 for HSM + threshold-escrow workstream (https://redwood.internal/INF-6120) :robot_face:

maya: Decision call: approve tokenized artifacts + threshold-escrow pilot (phase 1) and postpone ZK / full-auditor-plaintext-free options to phase 2? Reply +1/-1.

zhen: +1 from Eng, will scope POA.

sam: +1 from Sec if per-token audit logs + HSM sig present.

legal: +1 to pilot but legal wants to review pilot contract template first.

maya: Thanks all  680: filing RFC and adding to roadmap. Will schedule auditor demo next week.
